content.title: Bryan Adams announces 2026 U.S. tour: Full schedule, openers and ticket info
content.text: For fans who grew up blasting “Summer of ’69,” shouting along to “Run to You,” or soundtracking road trips with “Heaven,” Bryan Adams’ newly announced 2026 U.S. tour looks built for a big summer singalong. Adams is bringing “Roll with the Punches” back across the U.S. this summer with Pat Benatar and Neil Giraldo joining the run, giving fans a lineup packed with decades of arena-sized hits.The newly announced outing marks the second U.S. run of Adams’ “Roll with the Punches” tour. After touring North America with Benatar and Giraldo last fall, Adams will return for a 16-date U.S. stretch that begins July 24, 2026 in St. Louis and runs through August 16, 2026 in Milwaukee, with stops in New Orleans, Orlando, Baltimore, Detroit and more.Adams is touring in support of his 2025 album, Roll with the Punches, his 16th studio album. He’ll also release Tough Town on vinyl for Record Store Day on April 18, bringing the 10-song set beyond its original super deluxe edition release.Bryan Adams 2026 “Roll with the Punches” U.S. tour datesBelow is the full U.S. schedule for 2026. A Citi presale starts Tuesday, March 24, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. local time, while a Live Nation presale for Live Nation All Access members begins Thursday, March 26, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. local time.There is also a dedicated SeatGeek presale for the July 26, 2026 stop at Lucas Oil Live at WinStar World Casino & Resort in Thackerville, Oklahoma. SeatGeek is the Official Ticketing Partner of WinStar World Casino & Resort.When do Bryan Adams U.S. tour tickets go on sale?General public tickets for Bryan Adams’ 2026 U.S. tour dates go on sale on Friday, March 27, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. local time.For the July 26, 2026 concert at Lucas Oil Live at WinStar World Casino & Resort in Thackerville, Oklahoma, SeatGeek will be the primary stop for fans looking to shop tickets for that particular show.Who is opening for Bryan Adams on his U.S. tour?Pat Benatar and Neil Giraldo will support Bryan Adams on all of the 2026 U.S. dates.That gives this run an especially strong classic-rock pull. Benatar and Giraldo bring one of the most recognizable catalogs in rock, and their presence makes this tour feel more like a full-event night than a standard headlining set.
